newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA IN FIM 10 MLN TELECOMS DEAL WITH STOCKHOLM.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA IN FIM 10 MLN TELECOMS DEAL WITH STOCKHOLM.

text.p: Nokia said on Monday it sealed a deal to supply a telecommunications expansion and a network management system worth more than 10 million markka to a subsidiary of the City of Stockholm.

"Nokia Telecommunications and AB Stokab have signed a contract for the supply of telecommunications network expansion and a network management system to the City of Stockholm," Nokia said in a statement.
The delivery would include its PDH (Plesiochronous Digital Hierarchy) and SDH (Synchronous Digital Hierarchy) transmission equipment and a "state-of-the-art" network management system.
The first phase of the network will be in use in December 1996, Nokia said.
